name: nocpilot
description: NocPilot — jalankan backend + frontend + queue + scheduler dengan satu perintah

scripts.dev: npx concurrently -c "#93c5fd,#c4b5fd,#86efac,#fde68a" -n "api,queue,schedule,web" --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:queue" "npm run dev:schedule" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.setup: composer install --working-dir=apps/backend && npm install --prefix apps/frontend && npm install
